reviewFlags.issue: Zabilo calls this a Ceiling Air Conditioner, while Israeli listings sell it as עילי (wall-mounted). The mounting type must be checked.
Catalog 2,180 W conflicts with zabilo 2,700 W. Only one foreign retailer states it.
Catalog 28,320 and 28,660 BTU/h differ from the 29,000 and 28,000 BTU/h on zabilo and X-PRESS. X-PRESS does not label which BTU figure is heating and which is cooling, so the mapping rests on zabilo.
Warranty is not stated as a fact. Zabilo says 5 years, and Israeli listings found in search disagree (3 years, 5 years, 36 months). Check with the importer.
Catalog says A, zabilo and the Electra guide series say A++. Confirm against the EU energy label or EPREL.
Israeli listings write MAX INV 390 and the Electra 2026 guide writes ELECTRA MAX INVERTER 390. The name variant matches the same model, not a close code.
Some Israeli listings found in search say 2.5 כ״ס, others 3.5 HP. Zabilo says 3.5 HP and 29,000 BTU/h, which fits 3.5 HP. Confirm capacity on the product label.
Electra's 2026 technical guide gives indoor 1,259x369x283 and outdoor 890x342x673 mm, matching the outdoor size on Zabilo; catalog values differ.
Catalog name says 3.2 כ״ס; sources give 29,000 BTU/h and other listings say 2.5 or 3.5 HP. Confirm horsepower on the product label.
Zabilo calls it a ceiling unit while X-PRESS sells it as wall-mounted (עילי). Confirm mounting type.
Catalog BTU values, energy rating A, 2,180 W and both unit dimensions differ from the Electra 2026 guide and Zabilo. Update the catalog spec text.
The guide gives dimensions without axis order; outdoor 890 × 342 × 673 likely is width × depth × height. Confirm before stating width/height/depth.
Energy rating not verified on a page naming the model (catalog A, Zabilo A++). Check the energy label.

qa.notes: Kept cooling and heating capacity, indoor and outdoor dimensions and the Sabbath mode / self-cleaning feature from the Electra 2026 technical guide (names the model, corroborated by X-PRESS). Rejected power consumption, A++ rating, pipe connections, the Inverter and 4D features: their only ok quotes are on the Zabilo page, which does not name the model. Dimension labels changed to drop the width/height/depth order, since the outdoor figures (890 × 342 × 673) do not read as W×H×D.
